verdict.rationale: Twenty's workflow engine can trigger on record changes/schedules/incoming webhooks and chain an 'HTTP request' step (e.g., Slack alert on deal stage change), effectively enabling outbound webhook-style notifications for events — but there's no documented first-class 'webhook subscription' API where an external AI agent registers a URL to be notified of arbitrary CRM events. Missing for 10: explicit webhook subscription/registration endpoint or events API, documentation of supported event types/payloads for outbound webhooks, and independent confirmation this works reliably.
